steps.name: suspicious data
steps.objective: Talk to [Saraswati] in “Compartment 3” and check the data contents of the network. After checking, report the quest to [Saraswati].

lines.text: (Saraswati is deep in thought with her eyes closed. Then, perhaps sensing someone approaching, she opens her eyes and looks ahead.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Saraswati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'm sorry for making you come here every time. Since I can't leave the compartment... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, it's definitely not normal for Saraswati to suddenly appear as a hologram.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Thank you for your understanding. I'll tell you right away.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would like to ask Adventurer for help with a matter related to the hyperspace network.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Super space-time network… . I don't know anything... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Adventurer probably knows this too. Traces of Adventurer, who has many worlds and memories, are coming into this place... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It was possible to view and organize such data under my authority... .
(The moment Saraswati extends her hand, all monitors in the compartment are filled with black.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Only this data is in this state. Every time I try to access it, it's being denied.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Of course, as long as you don't touch this data, there's no problem. I'll reboot the system and try again.
(Saraswati's hands move busily. After a while, the monitor in the compartment returns to its original state.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: All you have to do is share access rights. The method is not difficult. Just putting your hand here is enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad it wasn't difficult.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Thank you. I think we can sort it out right away.
(As Saraswati explains, %s's hand rises above the open holographic window.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saraswati? Why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Could you please wait a moment?
(Following Saraswati’s hand gestures, the folders and documents in the hologram disappear.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would have told you that you can check if new data appears at some point.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This data is also related to Adventurer. but… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I don't want to recommend reading... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is that about? I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Just because Adventurer views it, nothing happens. but… . still… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I have data that I have permission to view, I can see it at any time, right?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes, it is, but it doesn't have to be now. ah… .
(At that time, a hologram of a being that has not been seen before appears in front of Saraswati.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Record? Query?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Miss Saraswati, %s, I apologize for appearing so suddenly.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: What is there to be sorry about? Because we're just doing our job.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Could you please be quiet for a moment?

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: You don’t like it? Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You two, it's been a while.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: It's going to be a long time for %s. Then let’s get to the point. that… .

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: %s, please check the data immediately.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Why are you taking my lines?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: It doesn't matter who does it first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are still the same. But is there a reason to check the data right away?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Let me explain briefly. Iris What does Yang do, they say, is building a great wall? It makes the job a little easier.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: You can say that that data is interfering with that work. Market stalls sometimes pile up boxes to the point where they block traffic.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Take that box away. If you check right now, the path will be clear.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Bro, that's my line.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: You don't think the brotherly bond is ruined because of something like this, do you? Anyway, it can be seen that each other's areas are blocked.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks for telling me. I'll check.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Thank you. I thought you would do it right away. Since business is over, we will leave.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Uh, are you going already? Whoa, I heard you just say what you have to say. I can't help it. I can't just go... . Then adios.
(The record and the Quarry brothers' holograms that were talking frantically disappear, and Saraswati looks straight at the place where the gates of hell were.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saraswati, why?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Are you sure you don't mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If so, I will set it up so you can view the data.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Saraswati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: That's it. Now, please put your hand here.
(The moment Adventurer's hand rises above the new window created by Saraswati, the appearance of the compartment slowly begins to change to a different place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it about? If it is enough to stop Saraswati from seeing it...)
(An unfamiliar space with a strange atmosphere behind the beautiful scenery, and in front of it, someone is talking in an angry voice.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: It’s unpleasant… .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Are you trying to convince me using human language, not even God?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Why did this land and this world, which I had protected and protected for so long, change like this? . I am… . For what reason have I... .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: This is the price you pay for protecting your life... .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: You will definitely say no. He must be the one who succeeded Ceres as the owner of the stars... .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: That doesn't mean it's forgiven.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: I, beings like us, worked for life and for them. Like a tool... . Yes, it doesn't matter if it's a tool.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Because I was treated like that, I ended up living like a tool. It's not even funny.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: But what's the point of an owner who can't even use those tools properly?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: I'm not blaming God. Just act according to God's will. Yeah, it doesn't matter who it is.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: If I determine that you are an obstacle, I will gladly kill you and use you as food for this place. Because that's the only reason I'm here.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: I don't know if those who exist for life will be happy... .

(When the person who seems to be the owner of the voice extends his hand, light begins to gather at the tips of his fingers. And through the gaps in the light, someone's appearance is revealed little by little.)
The light of ▒▒▒… .
(The moment someone's longing-filled name is called, the light turns into a huge spear and flies towards the enemy at high speed.)
(After a while, the enemy who failed to avoid the attack falls in place, holding on to the pierced chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… … .
(For a moment, you meet the enemy's lifeless eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me, it's me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I'm dead... ? What, what?
(Suddenly, lifeless eyes blink. As he reaches out to check on the fallen being, his pupils grow at a speed so fast that they fill the landscape.)
(The eyes, like the stickiness of a swamp, reach out to %s and grab the hand first, trying to suck it up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Please, please don't do this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please... .
(After a while, %s's appearance is completely swallowed up by the eyes and becomes invisible.)

steps.name: A different place where I was recognized
steps.objective: Talk to [Saraswati] in “Compartment 3” and report the quest to [Anis] in “Drifting City.”

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Come to your senses!
(The scene in front slowly changes into a familiar compartment. The appearance of a familiar figure is also recognized. And the appearance of the dying person is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saraswati… . I, I… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An unknown feeling comes over me.)
(%s's legs seem to have lost strength, and Saraswati catches him falling.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Are you okay? If you're having a hard time, go to Ishtar and get treatment... .
(%s's hand rises in front of Saraswati.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Sorry. I didn't know it would be this hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's because it's my first time doing something like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you please confirm a little more information? There's nothing I can know from this alone... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Although it's unlikely, why not go to the place where Adventurer recognized himself from another world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I seem to see that place in my head.)

choices.text: 1. Where I met the unknown children

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No, I talked to those kids about a lot of things, but I don’t think that was the case at the time.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Think again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hel, a goddess from another world, mistook me for someone else, but I never found out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Think again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I certainly heard many stories and had special experiences on the planet of nothingness, but that’s not it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s difficult….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Think again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That’s right. I met myself in a new time and space there….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The sad feeling I felt at that time seems to come and stab my heart.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happens there?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: There is no way to know… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and check it out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Please tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Data from the space-time network, that is, what I saw… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The power of those called gods cannot reach this place. So you won't be able to see it... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If their power was in full effect... .
(Saraswati seemed to have more to say, but stops.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Sorry. I said something pointless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. If anything happens, I'll go and explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Saraswati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes… . Please proceed carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I don't know what will happen, but it's still a good idea to go. If you don't go, you won't know anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go to the drifting city... .

steps.name: lost
steps.objective: Talk to [Anis] in “Drifting City” and take a look at “Drifting City.” Then report the quest to the person you see at the location you arrive at.

lines.text: (Anise, who was maintaining tools used in the field, looks at the sky with a worried expression.)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Phew, I have to go to Narsha... .

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Miss Anise.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Yes, I know.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I need permission to return to the guild union.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Miss Narsha will be fine. It is said that there was a misunderstanding, but thanks to the wizards of the Magic Agency, they returned safely.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Still, it's my fault. I went there because I recommended it.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Miss Anise, if you blame yourself, you will end up empty-handed. So let's stop.
(When Müller speaks firmly, Anis’s sullen expression returns.)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Have the agents still not discovered the identity of the explosion sound?

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: They said they checked the condition of the building, but had no idea. I'm a little worried because it happened in the process of finishing the investigation.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: There was nothing to achieve here, so the council probably wanted to sort things out.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Now, both I and Miss Annis will have a lot to do in Glaston. It seems like I've been here for quite some time, but I still don't know.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: It feels like 10 years, right?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Miss Anise, you seem to have relaxed enough to even joke. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Ah, God’s Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Anis, Lord Müller. How have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Still not welcoming...)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: It's been a really long time. How have you been?

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I heard that you saved travelers who got lost at the Nereis Gate.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Among the rescued people was a member of the Adelwald family. You're saying strange nonsense, saying you feel like a pig doll, do you know anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, well… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what's going on? Everyone looks busy.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I heard loud explosions one after another and was looking for what was going on.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Last time, a strange hole appeared, and this time, an unknown explosion sound... . Phew, I want to get out of here quickly, but I can't.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Sir Müller, everything will be fine.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: That's the way it is, Miss Anise. This is a strange place.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Now, what brings God's messenger here?
(With Müller’s question, Anise’s sparkling eyes turn to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… , I'm looking for something.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: I can't say it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Then, let me ask you one thing about something other than that. Is it something to do with the Empire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it. own… .

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Okay, okay. Then find it quickly and return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: You must be busy, so hurry up and go. Let’s meet up with you and Narsha sometime, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, anise is also good. Even Müller… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s like getting permission instead of permission. Then, let’s go.)
(While wandering through the drifting city, I suddenly feel an unknown sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? This shaking….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the ground shaking? I need to pass by quickly. uh?
(I tried to rush to another place, but my feet wouldn't move. I tried moving again, but the same thing happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
(An unknown shadow appears in the form of an oval in front of %s, who was unable to move as if someone was holding him down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw it at Rosengarten and Vanitas... .  Oh no!!
(The shadow gets bigger and starts to approach as if it is going to attack you. You get so embarrassed that you fall down and your fear of the shadow also increases.)
(At that time, green light rises from the floor and becomes a huge wall. The wall blocks the shadows that are about to swallow everything up at any moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa, whoa... . I lived... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Can you move your feet? Come on, let's go quickly.
(Suddenly, the black shadow grows bigger and blocks everything around %s except for the wall made of green light.)
(At that moment, something pops out from the wall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hand?
(A woman's unidentifiable hand gestures as if to come closer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who… ?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Take my hand, if you don't want to be swallowed up and disappear... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This voice…? I’m sure I’ve heard it before…)
(Suddenly, the woman's hand grabs the hand of %s, who was remembering the owner of the voice.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Trust me this time. You don't have to believe it next time. … For now, I will send you to the God who believes in you. Trust me.
(The owner of the hand pulls %s's hand with strong force.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Ugh!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The entire landscape is colored green...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The shadow that tried to swallow me is slowly moving away..., I am sleepy... this hand that held me...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where are you taking me...?)

steps.name: looking eyes
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in the “Room of the Oracle” and visit [Narsha] in the “Guild Alliance City Esnil”.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Go, suddenly. How did I get here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… , obviously I'm holding hands... .
(Iris approaches with surprised eyes and examines %s's condition.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What happened? are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did I suddenly come here... ? Obviously… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. So stay calm... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, yeah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's how it happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s not hesitate and tell everything to Iris….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Iris everything, including visiting Saraswati, checking the strange data, and visiting the drifting city.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … That won't be what %s looks like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I believe that too. Even if I recognize myself in another time and space that I don't know, nothing will change.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I've found what I need to do, so I'll try a little harder.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't mean to make Iris do more work... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No, it's okay. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … I found out that the places I didn't recognize were the Drifting City and Asgard. There's no reason not to recognize where %s's footsteps land... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Apparently, Asgard is a separate realm from Etoire, and the drifting city... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A place where multiple times collide. It is a place too complex to be defined by a single space and time.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s here, a place where the memories of %s from another world or another time and space meet... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There is no room for me to intervene right now. It might happen someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So who was the person who saved me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know yet, but I have a guess... . I'll tell you when I'm sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you. I'll tell you as soon as I find out.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If you are in front of the Eidos Gateway Goddess Statue, you can come to my location.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? It worked. I'll come see you anytime.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, you can. And Siam came out. He's not here right now, but he'll be back here often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. Because I got to come out... . But going back… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's right. We can't continue to have people who originally came from another world here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does Siam want to go back too? If Iris says that, then what….)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's one more thing to talk about. Could you please stay with Narsha for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have had eyes for Narsha for a long time. I don't know who the owner of those eyes is, but the power of that gaze is getting stronger.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … Please watch over Narsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. I'll find out who that is too. sorry. There isn't much to know yet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. There I am, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go to Narsha right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what do I have to do to get out? Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If you go back slowly, you can get to the front of the Eidos Gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, see you next time. Iris… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… .
(As Adventurer disappears, the face of Iris, who had been seeing him off with a smile, turns pale. Then he collapses in place.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ugh, I’m dizzy… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Iris Sheep? Iris Sheep!
(Siam, who happened to be in the oracle's room, hurries over to him. He tries to help him up, but Iris waves his hand and pretends that it's okay.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. Don't worry too much. If I hold on, everyone will be okay.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I'd like to tell you that it's okay to take a break sometimes, but... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because I can't be of any help... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No, Siam. Siam was like that back then, but he always comforts me. So Siam, just think about the future.
(Iris looks at Siam with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is what I must do after receiving the power of Ceres. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Because the rainbow and the moon will never be eroded... .

steps.name: What happened to Narsha
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] in 「Guild Alliance City Esnil」 about what happened. 
2. Next, talk to [Dana] and visit [Talos] in 「Knossos」.
3. After speaking with [Talos], report the quest to [Partisan Havarti] in [Knossos Road].

lines.text: (Narsha is deep in thought, with her ears pricked up and one hand on her chin. Madori, the magic golem on Narsha's shoulder, is also imitating the pose.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha? What are you thinking like that? Madori was also thinking about something... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer? hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, how are you?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, I've been doing well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing Narsha averting her gaze, something must have happened...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What topic should I ask? Hmm….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori looks more active than before.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori? Right? After being together all the time and going through many hardships, I think we communicate better than before.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: They are like friends and family to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But the high point?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ahaha, that's exactly what it says. It's nothing, Adventurer.
(Narsha avoids answering.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It would be better to talk about something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I recently went to the Nereis Gate for work.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Nereid Gate? Oh, that's right. I heard from the president that you helped people there recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, it was a bit complicated.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I went there a while ago and almost ended up going somewhere else… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oops… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to tell you... . I couldn't tell you because I didn't want to worry you.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Then I'll tell you what happened. I wasn't going to go to the Magic Agency for a while.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: However, Anise and Ambrosia thought of me and sent me an invitation.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is a magic seminar hosted by the Magic Agency. The theme this time is spirits and life. The location was not the Magic Agency auditorium, but the Sage's Tower.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Tower of the Wise?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, the Tower of the Wise.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I wanted to visit the Tower of the Wise someday, and I thought it wasn't a place I couldn't go to, so I told the president about it and went alone.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Of course, the president sent Raclette separately out of concern for me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I had to take the gate at Nereis Gate and go to that area, but I arrived at a place whose name I didn't know at all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is there a side effect to the gate again?)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It was a camp where wizards and archaeologists from the Ministry of Magic gathered. There is a historic site called Orcarium.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It was a private location, but everyone was surprised when I showed up with the magic golem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone would be surprised to see a magic golem with such an ego, even a small one.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wizards do a lot of special research, so they aren't surprised by most things. Some people already knew about the magic golem. However, the reason they were surprised was because I… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: She's not a normal human, she's a girl like this.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Moreover, he doesn't like being the owner of a special magic golem... , it was that kind of look in his eyes.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That's why I didn't want to leave Esnil... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Perhaps reading the atmosphere, a kind wizard showed me where the gate was. He said he would tell the other wizards... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But, something was strange. Part of the gate was destroyed. I heard that the gate was set up separately by the Magic Agency to allow access to the capital or other places... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The camp suddenly became noisy, so I went there… . A boy with ears and hands similar to mine was destroying the camp.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Moreover, he had a magic golem that was much larger than Madori. Not only will you mess up the camp with that golem... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something bigger happened.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I recognized a few wizards and ordered the magic golem to capture them. Then I climbed up to the cliff in the distance and dropped it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It was shocking. Doing something like that with a golem... . It happened so quickly that I couldn't stop it... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I made eye contact with that child for a moment, and his eyes were lonely. and… .
(Narsha is holding on to Madori and taking deep breaths as if she is not calming down.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Whoa... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Narsha will be okay. Mr. %s, tell me the rest. Let Narsha get some rest.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh, President… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Sorry, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Narsha. Then I'm resting. I'll talk to Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Come this way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you have any concerns? I saw you thinking about it earlier without even knowing I was here... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Are you worried? It's always there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: My identity is different from other people. And the future with Madori.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm doing this and that, but I'm still not sure.  But if you do it, you'll learn something, right?
(Narsha makes a slightly lonely expression and then pats the magic golem Madori.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I think I learned a little more thanks to Adventurer's help. thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I'll help you with anything I can.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hehe, yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It was a good conversation this time, but I don’t think it’s even about this topic….)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'll continue the rest of the story while Narsha rests, is that okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay, okay.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: After obtaining data from the Magic Agency, I found out that the boy who handles the magic golem is called 'No Name'.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I guess I didn't give it a separate name, so I started calling it Noname and it seems to have stuck.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: She has similar abilities to Narsha and has the same ears and hands. I don't know why he appeared there, but he must have something important to do.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Anyway, the fact that the boy killed the wizards doesn't change... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Narsha was almost framed as an accomplice, or rather as a sole offender, just because she looked similar to the boy and had a magic golem. But fortunately I was able to escape.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's fortunate that the wizards view Narsha favorably for helping the Magic Agency with its magic golem-related work.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Fortunately... . I can't believe I said this. I can't say this to Narsha.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Narsha was caught just because she looked different, and although Narsha was afraid, she was accepting the fact that she might die.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Because in the eyes of the people of the empire, he doesn't seem like a 'human'. To think that I am enduring such humiliation... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It’s frustrating… . The empire is barely this big... .
(Dana cannot overcome her indignant feelings and slams the cane she was holding on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's good for Narsha to get some rest, but I'm looking for a way to go again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it Orcarium?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I think I want to meet Noname and talk about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you planning to go there again? It must be dangerous... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But fortunately or not, all ways to get there are gone now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The warp magic of wizards under the Ministry of Magic and council nobles was also blocked.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's not the power of no name. It's not even the power of a magic golem... . I keep trying to take Gallet and Raclette with me, but it's not working.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I wish there was another route... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Huh? if… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Did the goddess tell you to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. He asked me to tell him that he had eyes for Narsha, but that he didn't know who they were.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: These are the eyes that see Narsha... . okay. Then, move as %s thinks. We'll do everything we can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll get ready and go. Ah, Mr. Dana… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's about finding a boy named Noname. Is it because of something else?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, that's right. It's a personal matter, but it's also related to the empire.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: 10 years ago, Barbatos teamed up with a witch and tried to take Shiina away. And the Magic Agency was also involved in that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What happened at that time….)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There has been no progress in work for 10 years... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Phew. Enough of the long story, I have to go now. I'll go first.
(Dana smiles and turns away. Raclette and Zelic, who had been waiting for some time, chase after her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana seems a bit in a hurry today... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I need to gather information first, who should I go to...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mad Golem… Ah, I was trying to touch Narsha’s Mad Golem Madori….)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The unpleasant face has come again.
(Talos shows %s and laughs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because I wanted to ask you something. I think Talos would be interested... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I didn't bring anything with me this time. Then it's a bit disappointing... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Let’s listen and judge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha's magic golem that you were interested in... .
(As soon as he says magic golem, Talos's displeased look changes.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ho... . Okay, go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought you would be interested. What's going on... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Talos about part of what Narsha experienced.)
(Talos' face, who was listening to the story, hardens little by little.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: There was another magic golem like that. How many more things like that are there at the Magic Agency? There are still things that need to be destroyed... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The child named Narsha somehow wasn't caught... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Phew… , that's a pain in the ass. Are you a person who specializes in this kind of thing? Since we are tied to the gods anyway, the outcome is obvious.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A magic golem usually moves when magical power is given to it. Most things in the Empire are like that. New models are continuously being released to make up for the shortcomings.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: On the other hand, what about the magic golem that Narsha has? It'll be a little different... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It looks like you brought something with you when you came.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't bring anything.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The area where the guerrilla guard post is located is noisy. How dare an idiot guerrilla capture a child... ..
(Talos frowns and looks toward the guard post at the entrance to the Knossos Road. Then he takes a step toward that direction.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos? If you're a kid... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Narsha… .

steps.name: The road to the Orcarium
steps.objective:
1. Resolve the matter with [Havati] in the ‘Knossos Road’ and go to meet [Minos] in the ‘Coffin of Acro’. 
2. Follow the passage in “Knossos” to “Orcarium Camp” and report the quest to [Peta].

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I am not that kind of person!!

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Don't talk nonsense!! He's a beastman with animal ears, beast hands, and even a magic golem. It's on the wanted flyer here!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The one wanted is a boy.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: I don't know anything about that. That's what prisoners do anyway. Savage and trying to kill humans... .

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: But what did you just say? ‘People’?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Again… .

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: I don't know what kind of trick they're planning, but it would be better if they were caught obediently. Because I don't want to kill you.
(Following Havarti’s hand gesture, the guerrillas who were with him run towards Narsha.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Well, stop it. Oh, me!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I have an imperial authentication card. This can guarantee my identity... .
(Havati takes Narsha’s card and shatters it.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: How dare you bring up the imperial family on the topic of prisoners? Where would a card like this be made? Immediately, catch this prisoner!
(The moment the guerrilla tries to grab Narsha's arm, Madori, the magic golem on his shoulder, pushes the guerrilla away.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Mado… lee?

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Subdue it by force... , uh?
(No sooner has Havarti finished speaking than the guerrillas next to Narsha collapse, bleeding.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Stupid imperial guerrillas.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: What is it? Talos! How dare you try to interfere with the affairs of the empire on the subject of a beast.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You talk as if something is happening. On the topic of imperial dogs. If you mess around with your mouth one more time and say something like “I’m a beast,” I’ll swallow you up. Or will it be blown into thin air?
Bang!

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Talos… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: … Did you know you would say that? I thought the assault rifle was a form, but it wasn't. If you want to kill him properly, aim for the head. This head.
(Talos casually removes the bullet lodged in his shoulder and points to the head of guerrilla Havarti.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Are you alive after taking this? What, what? Whoops, whoops.
(Havati complains of pain as Talos' hand grabs her neck. However, Talos just laughs as if it doesn't matter.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What did I say? Did it sound like a joke when you said you were going to blow it up into the air?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos, stop! Narsha is scared!
(Only then does Talos look towards where %s's voice is coming from. When he meets Narsha's shaking eyes, he quickly sighs.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Phew… … .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Okay. okay. I tried to do it in moderation and let it go.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Adventurer, you… .
(When Talos lets go, Havarti falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Havarti, I will guarantee Narsha’s identity, so please let her go.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Why are you on this prisoner’s side, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I can't help it. Should we try what the rabbit witch did?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'm not killing you. are you okay. Because I'm going to slightly erase your memory... .

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Creed's beastmen are imperial people... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I need to know this guy's grit. After

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If you don't finish it, both of you will get caught up in trouble. The bad guys in the empire will probably think this is the time to attack.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: How about the little one? I want to do what I want?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Even if I say no, you will do it.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That's right, I can do whatever I want in Knossos. Then I assume everyone agrees.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: What are you doing? What on earth did you do... .
(Talos shows a rotten smile and taps Partisan Havarti on the shoulder with his staff.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Ugh. Aaaaaaaaa!!
(Havati holds his head and begins to scream. The birds in Knossos seem startled by this sound and fly into the sky. They do this dozens of times….)
(At the end, guerrilla Havarti vomits blood and collapses. Narsha quickly approaches and checks Havarti’s condition.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He didn't die. I just lost my mind... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: This is how you lose all memory of us. Isn't it?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Kid. As the administrator of Knossos, I welcome you. Go see the Beast King right away. Originally, only %s could enter, but if you go together, you can enter.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Then, what I have to do is finished here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You give help in this way.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Don’t you just have to go wherever you go? Hurry up and go. If the Beast King gets angry again, Knossos will shake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Talos. thank you. Ah, I'm thankful for this... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: … Thank you.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What did I do? Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ah… . Kid.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As your magical power becomes stronger, you will be able to better control the magic golem. The magic golem will be able to understand your meaning better.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: (When that person appeared, Madori's movement to escape from my hand stopped...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did Narsha feel it too? Madori stopped because of Talos….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, let’s go.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .
(After confirming that Adventurer and Narsha have left, Talos looks around the guard post and discovers a suspicious object.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: This is the demon’s emblem… . Was this the reason why the guerrillas were more excited than usual? There is no way the Archduke would do something like this, and then… . hmm?
(Talos feels a deadly approaching and ducks away. Havarti, a ranger who has not yet fallen asleep, is struggling to load his rifle.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Come on, Talos, I will kill you.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What a pity. You're trying to kill me when you don't even have the strength to get up... . Does the method Daphne taught me not work on ordinary humans?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I can't help it. Then I have no choice but to swallow it.
(With those words, a huge shadow appears behind Talos' back like a whirlpool, and it attacks the guerrilla Havarti.)
(As soon as she enters Acro's coffin, Narsha stops and looks back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, why are you like this?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's nothing. I thought I heard a strange sound from where the man was... . By any chance, did you not hear anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It felt a little strange, but... . I didn't hear any sound.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's no big deal, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It'll be nothing.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer. There's something I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What kind of person is the Beast King?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know much, but I'll tell you briefly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is said that he was the ruler when the Sylvaria Empire was in conflict with Creed, the territory of the beastmen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know exactly what happened, but it is said that he was locked in Acro's coffin and slept for hundreds of years before waking up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I summarize what I experienced in Knossos and briefly talk to Narsha.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Something like that happened in Knossos... . I didn't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meet him and talk to him. Because I might be able to get an answer. Narsha, follow me carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because the road to meet the Beast King is a bit rough.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I was waiting for your visit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was surprised by the sudden attack. Not once or twice... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I couldn't recognize you because your aura had changed so much that I thought you were a different being. Ah, there is someone else to welcome. Welcome, child of the clan.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Me… ?
(Minos calls Narsha, who was hiding far away from the two sparring people.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Yes, child. Stretch out your hand.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah, yes, yes... .
(When Narsha extends her hand, Madori from her shoulder slowly comes down and heads towards Minos.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: As expected... … .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why is Madori going to that person?
(The magic golem approaching Minos turns and looks at Narsha.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Did you say this golem's name is Madori?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: As expected, seeing as he reacts to the name you call him, he appears to be the golem's chosen one. That's proof that we're part of the clan.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: We… family… . I look a little different... . My hands… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: That doesn't matter. Because our clan is the only one chosen to be the owner of a golem filled with life. Return the golem to its original owner.
(With a gesture from Minos, the magic golem Madori returns to Narsha’s side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minos?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: For the first time in a while, memories from a long time ago came to mind and I was unable to speak.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: %s, if you brought this child, something must have happened. Tell me that story.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: And boy. What is your name?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Narsha… It is said.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: A being that will fly high... That's a good meaning.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I'm sorry, Narsha. If I hadn't been trapped here, you would definitely be living a better life than you do now... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you just for your words. I'm fine. Because I'm doing well.
(Narsha is smiling, but there is a hint of sadness on her face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is Narsha okay?)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Narsha, tell me your story.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yeah, that's... .
(Narsha tells Minos everything she experienced in Orcarium without leaving out anything.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Looks like there's another kid walking around with a golem. If you see that child in the orcarium... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can guess something.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Ordinary golems move with magic power. It would be no different if machines were mixed with soil to form what it is today.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: When the Empire invaded, they took our golems, studied them, and improved them, but there were still some things they couldn't solve.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: A golem with an ego... , the kind with Narsha is not made because you want to make it.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: There must be a spirit-like determination, and only we who can feel it can move.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The story goes that the people of Kali and Knossos are related to spirits...)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Maybe that's why. When you see the empire's wizards digging into the place, and the child carrying the golem trying to find something... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There must be something there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It must be a power related to spirits, right?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: That's right. Orcarium is a place of light that awakens spirits.
(Minos thinks about something for a moment and sticks the staff he was holding into the ground. After a while, Knossos, including Acro's coffin, shakes slightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… ?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: They said there was no way to the Orcarium, so I made it. If a person goes there, that place will become a path... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: %s, I have a favor to ask. Please help this child and go to the Orcarium. The goddess also told me to help this child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Minos. But what is the box behind there?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: This box? Ah, that just worked out well.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Narsha, I have something to give you. I found it at the ruins of a collapsed castle a few days ago.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Zerenis gave it to me as a token of friendship a long time ago, but now Pasiphae and I don't need it, so I'm giving it to you. Now, take it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It is a protective costume with Zelenis' magical power left behind. They said it was designed to suit a child who handles golems.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: They said that if a child were born between me and Pasiphae, we would get along well... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: … Would you mind giving me something so precious?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Minos looks sad….)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Every object has its own owner, but it seems like this one is yours.
(Narsha is speechless when she receives the box of clothes from Minos.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go change right away. I'd like to show you what I'm wearing... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: … There's a long way to go, so hurry up and leave. Oh, you don’t have to come here after work… . I'll hear from you later from %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Then, Minos, we will go to the Orcarium.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'll be back, Minos.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: After… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I never thought it would sound so nice to hear that I'm back... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow… .
(As soon as you step foot, the surrounding scenery changes in an instant. The forest of Knossos disappears before you know it, turning into a mysterious place where the sea and river meet.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I came to the path opened by Minos and found myself at Orcarium Camp. Coming straight from the El Anor Mountains to the western part of the continent... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure. It's fascinating. I think I might go back... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: These clothes that Minos gave me are so light. I think it's perfect for me. It's so pretty too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It definitely suits Narsha well. I feel like I woke up because the atmosphere changed.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Awakening? It's good, right? I'm not sure, but I'm glad to hear that it suits you well. lol.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh! Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I think there's someone at the camp over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A wizard holding a large book. Where did you see it?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: … Are you from the Ministry of Magic?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be afraid and follow me. I will take the lead.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer.

steps.name: so that I can understand
steps.objective: Defeat [Happy Moreni] and [Mado Number Zero] in “Orcarium” and report the quest to [Peta].

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Haam… . I'm sleepy, I'm hungry... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I thought I would be successful when I returned to the headquarters, but to be dispatched again... .
(Peta is shocked and speechless when he sees the two people approaching the camp.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: What is it? You won't be able to enter here without permission from the Magic Agency... . Wait, those two... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Adventurer said that even so, that child carrying a golem is definitely not the criminal. You're telling me to do something on my own.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'll have to give it a rough look and send it to you. That Adventurer will only bring a lot of trouble... .
(Peta seems to have prepared herself mentally and greets the two with a business smile.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, that smile bothers me...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s been a while, Peta.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I see, what is Gerda’s job… . By the way, what brings you here? That kid... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hello, wizard. I came because I had work to do.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Hmm, where are you from? All paths to get here are blocked.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Well, I guess you figured it out.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: According to imperial law, anyone other than those related to the Ministry of Magic is currently prohibited from passing through this place.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I would like you to wait until the rest of the Ministry of Magic arrives.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If not, what will you do?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Orders were given to detain new recruits for trespassing. In fact, it would be impossible for me, a mere wizard, to deal with Adventurer, who has become a monster through his skills.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a monster.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That's what it means. Since you've come this far, please show me something I can understand.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Are you asking for money or something?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: No, I'm going to eat. The only way to replenish magical power is to eat... .

lines.speaker: 냐르샤
lines.text: When it comes to food, there’s a lot.
(Narsha takes out a small pocket and puts her hand in it. Then she starts taking out cakes and bread without stopping.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is a food storage bag made by Zelic in the style of his hometown village. It is said that if the horsepower is kept constant, the temperature will be kept constant and enough bread can fit a house.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Oh... , it’s fascinating. I don't know who Zelic is, but I want this item.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No way. This is mine. I'll give you plenty of food, so don't be greedy!

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'm not the type of person who prefers cake, but I can't help it because I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Peta, eat the food later and help me out. You know what this is, right? Please help me.
(Peta looks surprised when I show him the imperial authentication card I took out of my pocket.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Ho... , I'm jealous. Ordinary people can't have it even if they die... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's good because it's a card certified by the imperial family, so your identity is certain and you can receive other benefits.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: From my perspective, there is no need or reason to stop the owner of this card... . However, if an accident happens, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Just please don't let it harm me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's been a while since I've seen someone this twisted.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: They also gave us cake to fill our stomachs, so I'll briefly tell you about the situation here.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Ah… .
(The moment Peta is about to speak, there is an uproar about what happened in the Orcarium outside the camp.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's noisy outside the camp because the killer is still wandering around the Orcarium.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Not only do animals show strange movements, but also demons and demons that you have never seen before appear, as well as suspicious spirits and golems.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Could you help me for a moment while I eat? I want to fight him, but I'm out of magic... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, okay. Then I won't let you come to the camp, so be sure to tell me when you get back.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, let’s go together. I will help you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, wait a moment. It could be dangerous, so I’ll come back quickly.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, I will. Hey, Adventurer, wait a minute… .
(Narsha raises her tiptoes and whispers quietly.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: … He may change his mind, so I will continue to feed him. And since I've got a map here, just go there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh… .  all right. They are feeding me well.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I knew Narsha was good at work, but she does it like this too.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Then let’s go… .

steps.name: Explore the Orcarium
steps.objective: Defeat [Calm Alfarin] and [Archivist Dantalion] in “Orcarium” and report the quest to [Narsha].

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: The cakes and breads of the Hmong Monggeul Guild... . I only heard about it, but I didn't know you could eat it like this.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: … You are truly amazing. How can you eat all that? Maybe without even telling the person in front to try it.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: When wizards focus on magic, they can barely see. That's how I am.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You speak well.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Is that so? Hehe… . Oh, hey, Adventurer is coming.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing special happened here, right?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes, the camp was uneventful except that I ate a little more than usual. thank you

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As promised, please tell me the situation here.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Actually, I don't have much information, so I'll keep it brief.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: There is no other name for the murderer, so I will call him No Name, just like my superiors call him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No name… .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: As you probably already know, Noname is the same as Narsha here... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: After causing an incident here, he went inside the Orcarium and has yet to show himself.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I understand that it is moving at certain times... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: … The Magic Agency has created a sample of Noname's unique magical power flow. I thought only magicians from the Ministry of Magic registered such things, but there was a Noname one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's no coincidence that Noname attacked the magicians.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's a job done by higher-ups, so low-level wizards like me don't know much about it.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: If Noname's magic doesn't resonate with the tools I have for a long time, it's almost dead.  Then all I have to do is notify the main office... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Other than that, I don't know. There are more, but for security reasons I can't tell you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Then please let me know about Noname. Adventurer, don’t you know something too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha and I came here because we wanted to know something. There is no information about Noname.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It doesn't necessarily have to be a no name.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Adventurer has already met god-level beings, so it doesn't make sense if you don't know anything.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Don't you know that the Magic Agency is conducting various experiments?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Just like putting food into a new bowl, we put a new soul into the created body. The mini golem here now is in that form, and if you use the life force of the spirit... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: The explanation will be complicated. These are things that are difficult for the general public to understand... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, what did I just hear? Is that really what the Magic Agency does?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?
(Narsha quietly pulls %s’s collar.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Let's go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should do that.
(As Adventurer and Narsha prepare to go out of the camp, Peta looks surprised.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Adventurer, are you going to leave like this? Is there really anything you want to talk about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Peta, thank you. I'll just leave.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Then there is nothing we can do. I have provided convenience and received help... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Goodbye. If you still need help, come back to camp.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, thank you. Wizard.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes, we'll talk about golems later when we get a chance.
(When the two people disappear and the camp becomes quiet, Peta takes something out from between the large magic book she was leaning against.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Looks like Noname is on the move... .  Should I go and tell you? No, let's chase after it first.

steps.name: Spirit's Voice
steps.objective: Talk to [Narsha] in “Orcarium” and look for [No Name]. Then come back and report the quest to [Narsha].

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I never thought the wizard would come after me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It will be okay because I got bullied. I wish I could go back to camp.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?
(Narsha looks around and pricks her ears. She seems to be concentrating on a sound coming from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I hear a strange sound.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Have you by any chance not heard of Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I didn't hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? Does Narsha hear things that I can’t?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, can you explain?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I keep hearing a voice chattering somewhere.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I think Madori recognizes it too. I think I'm looking at a spirit that was on the path we passed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Minos said that the golem is the result of a spirit... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You said this is the place of light where the Orcarium awakens the spirits, right?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Perhaps what I hear is the voice of a spirit.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I have a question. Can spirits communicate with humans?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was surprised because it was an unexpected question. We made sense from the beginning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, who was with Iris, and Narin, who was with Gerda's Io... . I don't think there were any problems communicating with spirits that had been with people for a long time.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm, I see… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Are these only spirits that materialize and appear in front of people? .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh? what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you hear another sound?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That's not it... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I feel a similar type of power as Madori's energy. It feels much more powerful and stable than Madori. That means… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No name… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, follow me. For now, let’s be careful.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .
None.
Why isn't there one? why? why!
(In a quiet corner of the orcarium, in the center, a boy is searching for something, pricking his ears on top of his head.)
I've been looking for it several times... . There's no way it doesn't exist... .
Is this sound a spirit?
(The boy turns his head in the direction from which the suspicious sound is coming from.)
A golem?
I was mistaken.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Who were you talking to?
Pretending to be friends just because we saw each other once... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That kid is Noname….)
I thought you ran away, but you're back? Not even scared. Plus, there's this unsophisticated person who comes with him.
(A boy dressed up in a stylish costume raises his hand and points to Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, this is my first time hearing that it’s tacky… . No name.
(As soon as the boy hears the name Noname, he laughs.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: It's not my name, but call it whatever you want. Because I am like that anyway.  The people of the empire don't need a name... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Phew, I'm getting tired of talking about this while watching something tacky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What’s wrong with my clothes….)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How did you get into the Orcarium? I would have blocked all the routes leading here.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The wizard holding the large magic book came somehow, but he didn't get in the way, so he left it alone.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Ah… , as expected, you cleared the way. Are you also a human from the Magic Agency like that wizard?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: No? Or not. Then I have nothing to do? You'd better go back. I also have nothing to do with you.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Isn't that good for each other?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There's something I want to ask you.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why did you do that?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why do people... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Do I really have to tell you?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Now that you know a certain amount, what more do you want to know? If I were to tell you, this little boy couldn't even handle it... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm like you... … .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I don't want to hear it. What do you want to say to a subject who lives freely among humans?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Get out of the way… . Because it has nothing to do with you.
(As Noname slowly passes by Narsha and Adventurer, a huge magic circle unfolds beneath his feet.)
(Then Noname’s movements stop.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: A magic circle, or rather a magic trap, created using the Magic Agency's unique technique.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way, Peta… .
(No sooner has he finished speaking than Peta appears behind Narsha and %s.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer. Thanks to you, I was able to catch Noname.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Peta, wait a minute. If you approach Noname like this... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Adventurer, outsiders, please leave. This is the Ministry of Magic's business, and even if your status is confirmed by the imperial family, in front of the Ministry of Magic... .
(The moment Peta spoke to Adventurer, Noname laughs as if it were ridiculous. Then, he slowly walks in front of Peta.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Did you really think you could bind me with a magic circle of this level? I, who had become a mortar of all kinds of curses and magic... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Damn, why am I muttering this… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Lyricaria.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Kill them all... … .
(With the words Noname, a being that was not there before appears above his head and approaches Peta at high speed.)
(In such a short time that there is no time to do anything, the large impact caused by metal colliding creates thick sand dust and shakes the space.)
(As the dust disappears, the appearance of the large magic golem with Noname that Narsha had mentioned is revealed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a magic golem... . uh?
(The golden magic golem's arm, which was trying to attack Peta, seems to be caught by something and unable to move.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori… ?!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wizard, run away!

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes? Ah, yes!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Where are you running away?
(At the word of No Name, the Madogolem shakes off Narsha's Madori that was holding it. Then, it aims at Peta's back as it runs away with the gatling gun attached to its arm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it!
(Adventurer raises a weapon and attacks the Mado Golem, and under Narsha's instructions, Madori acts as a shield to block the Gatling bullets.)
(As Peta runs away, Noname's expression hardens. The magic golem stops its action and steps back along with Noname's facial expression change.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The joke ends here. If you continue to disturb me, I will kill you both.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It won't happen that way.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What do you want so much that you have to kill someone?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: To give back as much as I suffered.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Wizards? Nobles in parliament? Everyone related to the empire... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's a dangerous guy, we have to stop him... Was this why Iris asked for Narsha?)
(As Noname's angry voice continues, Narsha, worse than anyone else, screams.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Stop it!!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: On a topic that grew up carelessly among humans... . Even though the name is Narsha... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Why do you think you have that golem? Do you know why the humans from the Magic Agency were called back to the Magic Agency?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What would have happened if you weren't the right person for the golem or something? Same as me... , keke… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The story is… . Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I had a guess... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I guess that's the answer now, right? Don't disturb me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That's not a reason to kill everyone.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: … I have heard your answer, so here… .
(Noname perks up his ears and looks somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Has it appeared now? I feel it... . All this time, you were observing the situation and holding your breath.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Anyway, it doesn't matter... .
(Noname, who continued speaking incomprehensibly, climbs on top of the magic golem.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Lyricaria, there's what we're looking for. let's go… .
(As if Noname was possessed by something, he boarded the magic golem called Lycaria.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No name!!
(Leaving behind %s's cries, Madogole Lyricaria flies up into the sky and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, it's late.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are we going?
(Narsha's ears perk up as she looks at the sky with Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I hear a loud noise. Over there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the way we came. Hey, Narsha… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes? Oh, I'm fine... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's just a little frustrating. Hehe.
(Narsha smiles lightly and stretches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We don't yet know what Noname is looking for, but let's find out first. Then you will know what it is.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes!

steps.name: What Noname Wants
steps.objective: Defeat [Madogolem Lycaria] in “Enteleche of Life” and return to [Narsha] to report the quest.

lines.text: (Narsha's ears become busier as she returns to the place where she stayed briefly before meeting Noname.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ugh… .
(Narsha's expression keeps changing, perhaps because %s cannot hear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is it very noisy?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's not noisy. I can't say exactly... .
(Narsha raises her head and looks around.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm hearing sounds coming from various directions, and it seems like they're calling me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you calling Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Can I go there first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, it’s dangerous over there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's still dangerous to be here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't leave Narsha alone, and I can't tell her to stay at camp...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Let's go together.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I promise. I won't be a burden. Because there is also Madori.
(Madori, the magic golem on Narsha’s shoulder, shakes her body as if she understands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori seems to be more active than before.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Right? Hmm… . I definitely feel like I can feel Madori’s mood better now that I’m wearing the clothes that Minos gave me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we go?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes! I will take the lead.
(The moment Narsha goes ahead and Adventurer tries to follow, an unknown feeling comes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This ominous feeling... is similar to when looking at a record...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s act calmly, otherwise we won’t be able to find Noname….)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There's a door up here. But in front of here is a cliff… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The door has something like spirit wings. I can definitely feel the magic inside.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why are you calling me? I am… , I am… .
(As Narsha extends her hand, the door shakes. After a while, a strong wind blows out from inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's a wind so strong that I can't stand it...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Narsha?
(When the wind calms and you look ahead, an unbelievable sight unfolds before your eyes. The wind flowing from inside the door is lifting Narsha into the air and surrounding her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take my hand... .
(The moment Adventurer hurriedly reaches out and tries to grab Narsha, the wind catches Narsha and Adventurer and sends them to the world inside the door.)
Boom!
(In the blink of an eye, the wind disappears and Adventurer, which was caught, falls from thin air to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Suddenly the wind blew us here. Uh, Narsha?
(I come to my senses and look around, but Narsha is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha? Narsha… There is no. Where is it? Rather, where is this place?
(The world that entered the door looks completely different from the Orcarium, which was filled with bright light just a moment ago.)
(The pillars extending from top to bottom have been destroyed, and a suspicious wall with ominous colors has been built on the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cave? That's not it either. Here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If… … .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: I never wanted to see you again... , this place is open... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who, who is it?
(When I look around at the sudden voice, a young man with blond hair and shining eyes slowly appears.)
It may be that places that could not be seen unless God opened them have reopened... . Yeah, I was wrong... . I was looking forward to it... .
(Cold, sharp wings emerge from behind the young man. Then, a sphere of light rises around them, brightening the surroundings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirit… ?
I should show respect to you for receiving the blessings of the Old Gods, but I don't want to. I even brought an uninvited guest... .
I am El-Larsa, following Orca.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa? Ah, I have heard your voice in the mountains of El Anor.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: That voice still remains.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you know this place well, could you help me? I need to find someone.
(As El-Larsa's expression hardens, the sphere of light hovering around becomes a long, large window. And with a gesture of his hand, it passes by %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I don't want to hear such orders from you. There's no need to kill humans anyway... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Instead, I promise you just one thing.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Go back. I will not harm those who are merely tools for the gods.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: It would be a different story if you broke this promise. Orca-sama also gave permission... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't go. I have to find Narsha... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Is it a hybrid born from a mixture of the witch's unclean energy and the spirit's power?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will not let you forcefully open and invade the Enteleche of Life that was sealed... .
(As soon as El-Larsa finishes speaking, the sphere of light hovering around him turns into a flash of light and begins to explode.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it’s dazzling.
(As the flash subsides, the scene returns to what El-Larsa called the 'Enteleche of Life'.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa disappeared... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha is recognized as a ‘hybrid’… . Narsha is probably not what the spirit said... . ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No name… , Is Noname here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha is dangerous. I need to find it quickly.
(While wandering through the Enteleche of Life, a roar is heard that fills the space.)
Ku-kwa-kwa-kwa, ku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, the ground is shaking.
Kku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwak!!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The spirits are talking about being here, so why aren’t they there?! I got rid of all the demons that got in the way, so why aren't there any?!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Lyricaria, destroy everything!!
Kwakwakwakwakwak!!
(Following Noname’s instructions, Madogole Lyricaria is destroying the pillars and walls in front of us.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No name!!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How did you get in? Unless it's the power of the spirits here... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Oh, that kid… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha and you are in danger if you stay here. I have to get out.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: … I can't get out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The spirit guarding this place might kill them both.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Since you're trying to kill me, I guess you're a hybrid, sheesh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I know El-Larsa said she was a hybrid….)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Did you hear that too? That spirit called me a hybrid... . I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Kkkkk, kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk... .
(Noname’s eyes turn cold for a moment.)
