lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: … Don't disturb me, human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you go out, Narsha will be safe too.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: It’s annoying… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You and that little boy... . A human being who can be with everyone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Noname, come to your senses… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: That's it. I won't listen to you. I, I!! I am… !!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: All you have to do is find what you need!!
Boom!
(With a huge sound, the Madogole Lyricaria falls in front of Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Lyrica… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Tear that person apart... .
(The movement of Magic Golem Lycaria slows down, and fragments that appear to be parts fall to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I've dealt with golems a few times, but Lyricaria is on a different level. It can't collapse like this...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But where is Narsha?)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Why are you so persistent? Rikaria, the final attack... .
(Noname looks at the staggering Magic Golem Lykaria in confusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The golem's movements are strange...)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Lyrica… ?
Kku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwak!!
(The moment Noname approaches to check the condition of Mado Golem Lykaria, Mado Golem creates a huge explosion, blowing Noname and Adventurer away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… . What is this explosion?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Ugh, why is Lyricaria… .
(When Adventurer and Noname came to their senses and looked at Likaria, the pillar in the air and the wall behind them hit Likaria.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Lyricaria?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… . To save Noname... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Considering Madori's actions to save Narsha, I'm guessing Lyricaria did something like that as well.)
(At that time, the magic golem Lycaria slowly rises from among the fallen rubble.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Let's stop for today. My efforts just so happened to be in vain.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Narsha!!!!!!!
(With a shout of No Name, Madogole Lyricaria rises into the air and throws the ax she was holding towards the wall in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No name!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
(Licaria's ax, which was thought to hit the wall, slowly rises. After a while, the beings holding the ax also begin to appear.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I can't believe I had to see the sleeping golem and spirit egg awaken because of the little boy... .
(While the mini golems are throwing Rikaria's ax elsewhere, Narsha suddenly appears and approaches %s's side.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, but where has Narsha been all this time? No matter how hard I searched, I couldn't find it... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The wind that brought it in dropped it where it is. I didn't want to touch it, but it felt like it was calling me... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The fragment engraved with Enteleche's power, I had to have it... . It seems like the spirits here wanted you to hang out more than me... .
(Noname looks at Narsha with a resigned expression.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No name.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I scared the kid so he wouldn't come here again, but he came with this person... , I ruined everything.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Noname, what is this power? You know.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Yes, this is what happened. Let me tell you… . That is the spirit power that remains in El-Larsa's realm. Only then can the dying spirits come back to life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa is the spirit of light who protects the Orcarium.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wait a minute. Does that mean I have that power?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Yes, kid. congratulations! Consider that you have received a good gift. Now, the spirit has turned on its eyes and is looking for us hybrids. To kill and get rid of it.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Even so, El-Larsa's judgment would have been distorted by now. While you were asleep, the humans from the Magic Agency turned the Orcarium upside down.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: But what if the one who took that power was you, the one who awakened the golem at the Magic Agency? Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: It's annoying, but it's kind of funny... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: you should know Awakening a magic golem and becoming its master is by no means a blessing.
(After finishing speaking, Noname jumps up from his spot and grabs the waiting Mado Golem Lycaria.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I hope I never meet that person again. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should I go?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: For plan B.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Oh, before I go, let me tell you some information that the spirit is curious about.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The orca you were looking for is dead. He was killed by the ancient gods. And some of that power is transferred to humans... .Wow… .
(Suddenly, a huge arrow of light flies out, pierces Noname's chest, and then gets stuck in the wall.)
(The magic golem Lycaria, which lost its owner and stopped moving, falls down with Noname.)
Boom.
(Then, as if he was watching, El-Larsa's voice is heard shaking the enteleche of life.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사의 목소리
lines.text: I heard something I didn't want to hear.
(As the voice disappears, the spirit of light El-Larsa appears in front of the fallen Noname.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The spirits said. The name of the spirit of light who protects the Orcarium... . El-Larsa… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Narsha, step back. El-Larsa seems to be different from other spirits... .
(El-Larsa looks at the wary Adventurer and Narsha with empty eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is he under the influence of another power like Hayden?)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I am the spirit who guards this place. I did what I had to do... . Judgment for destroying the place where spirits are born.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Child of Creed.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Do you know what power you have taken? It is the power for dying spirits to be reborn.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I didn't take it. The spirits here entrusted it to me. This place is contaminated, so leave it in a safe place... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: It’s unpleasant… . You're not even a god, you're trying to persuade me using human language... . Just because the spirits help life doesn’t mean you can do it carelessly!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute this means….)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Whether this place is polluted or not, the power lies in this place, itself. Hybrids covet it. I, El-Larsa, the administrator, will get it back in my own way.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will seal this place forever using a hybrid of a person who receives God's protection and the power of Enteleche. Don't let even the gods get close... .
(Without Adventurer and Narsha having time to say anything, El-Larsa's mocking figure disappears. After a while, the ground everyone was stepping on shakes and cracks little by little.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, an earthquake?!
(A black shadow rises through the crack and gradually begins to swallow the things in front of it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not an earthquake! Narsha, we have to get out of here quickly.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: We have to take Noname out… . If treated quickly… . I know it doesn't make sense, but still... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's hard to explain, but this place is like the other side of the Orcarium. If you don't get out quickly, you'll be trapped forever. I could die like this... .
(Narsha is staring blankly at Noname and the Madogolem Rikaria being swallowed in a black shadow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wake up, Narsha!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Then follow me. The spirits say there is a way out if you go that way!!
(Narsha, who came to her senses, grabs %s's hand. Then, she runs towards the place where she can see a faint light, avoiding the black shadow that is chasing her as if swallowing her.)

steps.name: Shadow of the Orcarium
steps.objective: Defeat [El-Larsa] in “Spirit Stump” and return to [Narsha] to report the quest.

lines.text: (As a result of continuing to run towards the light, following the wind flowing outside, the two were able to get out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Haha… , ha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Although we came out, the door to the Enteleche of Life still remains. Narsha, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ha, ha... . I'm fine.
(Narsha catches her breath and looks like she's okay, but she looks a little tired.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori, I'm fine. Now, look. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha… , what happened in here… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer must have experienced something like this a lot, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've experienced it a few times. Still, I was able to overcome it thanks to the help of many people.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Can I do that too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much because you're doing well.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I am not a hybrid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's natural. Minos called Narsha a child of the clan, and I think Medea recognizes it to some extent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like the Kali people are also related to spirits... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If you listen to the stories of the spirits... , El-Larsa seems to misunderstand me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And they told me that I was born out of love and that I was good at handling golems.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: However, Noname is different from me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find out about Noname. Narsha only needs to worry about Narsha now.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But do spirits tell such stories?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, from the moment I hold the fragment of Enteleche, I can hear the voice more clearly. It's just comfortable.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, why?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I think El-Larsa misunderstands. It was not Noname who opened the Enteleche of Life, and I am not a hybrid... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But, how could a spirit called a manager not know this fact?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The spirits said that the reason they entrusted the fragment of Enteleche to me was for this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Narsha the story of a spirit that tried to harm humans.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Are you saying that El-Larsa may be contaminated?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure... . First, I need to meet El-Larsa again.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit as strong as El-Larsa cannot be left alone if it is contaminated. It might not be good for Iris either... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Still… . ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, why are you like this?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I can hear the spirit's voice. This is... . Ugh, uh… , ugh… .
(Narsha pricks her ears to hear the spirit's voice and suddenly feels pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, wake up!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: El-Larsa's voice... . eww… … .
(Madori flies up and covers Narsha’s ears with both arms.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori, thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hey Adventurer. El-Larsa had something to say.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Come to [Spirit Stump] alone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you have something to say? Maybe it could be a good opportunity. If El-Larsa is waiting there, I don't think she'll come out.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, let’s go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way. It's dangerous. It's a spirit that protects the Orcarium, so it's best to be careful because you never know how it might threaten you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, first listen to me. Right now, I only think about Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you still hear the spirit’s voice?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Although he's quiet, I think he'll answer if I talk to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you please ask if Peta is still in the Orcarium?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: They say they're still at camp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? Then, Narsha, while you wait for me here, if you don't come back, go to camp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The people at the Magic Agency must have had an idea and set up a camp there. Besides, Peta is a skilled wizard... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't have to worry. Because there is Iris. I've endured well so far, so somehow things will work out this time too.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, if you say it that way, there is nothing we can do about it. Go quickly before I stop you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Madori, please take care of Narsha.
(As Madori moves as if she understands, Adventurer, who sees what she is doing, hurries towards the direction of the spirit stump.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I didn't even tell Adventurer to be careful.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori, maybe you were a spirit too... .
(When you open the door with green spirit wings and enter, the scenery you see changes.)
(An unfamiliar place with trees stretching out toward the dark sky and clear water flowing beneath them. However, unlike the Orcarium, it looks lifeless.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the spirit’s stump tool… . Actually, I can't see anything left after the tree was cut down... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why do all the plants seem to be dead... . The Orcarium is beautiful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you seen Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If you talk to yourself like this, you might get an answer at least once, but that's not the case here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is the power of Iris out of reach here...?)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: There is no answer from the goddess.
(El-Larsa slowly walks out from among the shabby old trees without any leaves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa… .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: This means that it is a place that is still invisible to the eyes of the goddess.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I don't blame the goddess.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: It is noble to become a god for this planet where there were only a few ancient gods. I do not blame the person who did such a noble deed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I hope El-Larsa will stop doing what he is doing.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: You say that because you know what I'm trying to do, right? I can't quit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe. Is it contaminated by some other force?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: That only applies to weak beings. You saw me easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I am a spirit. A being who lives for God and life from the moment he opens his eyes... . I have to do my job. We must protect this place and keep it alive. That's my mission... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Even if you are a being blessed by God, even if you are here by God’s will… .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I want to ask for your sins that happened here. This is my own matter that not even the goddess Iris, not even the goddess Gaia can touch... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Referee.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa… .
(The moment Adventurer tries to raise his weapon, El-Larsa explodes the sphere of light around him, blocking his movement.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: If you attack me now... . All spirit trees born with the power of life will die.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: If that happens, there will be no more spirits born... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will be waiting inside the spirit stump. Come there.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: If you do not arrive within the set time, everyone, including this place, within a certain radius will die.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what? Such nonsense... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I don't feel like it, but I have to do that to get you to come.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will wait there. Of course, the road to meet me will not be easy. Because the beings remaining here will help me make my decision.
(El-Larsa disappears, leaving only what she has to say.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why would El-Larsa do such a ridiculous thing? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … We have to stop it. Let’s go quickly… .
(At the end of the road, where broken spirit wings and waterways mix together to create a strange atmosphere, El-Larsa is waiting for Adventurer with the stump of what was once a huge tree.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: There must have been many demons and demons that came here, but we made it this far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa, listen to me. What's the point of fighting like this?!

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Even after coming this far, you still have the will to persuade me... . I don't like it. Because he is a human being whom God cherishes, he is full of arrogance from head to toe... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Do you know that everything will work out the way you want? . Things don't always happen just because you want them to.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Spirits like me are like that, and you, humans, have probably been like that too. And so is this world. Memories of unwanted pain and destruction... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: You have a very curious expression.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: A time when twilight is over and the light of the continent is almost lost to the being called the Demon King... . Fortunately, the light did not disappear.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: What Ceres, Gaia, and the few remaining gods protected was not only life, but also the source of light.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Source of light….)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: The primordial power of light illuminating the world gave birth to not only life but also spirits, and allowed them to live. And I kept it from being swallowed up by the corrupting darkness.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I stayed here waiting for Orca and guarded the light... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: While this place was preserved, many lives on this land contributed. They were intelligent and followed God.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I watched them for a long time. Just like Gaia does... . However, they split up in an instant.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Just as Freios was torn apart by the greed of the gods, they fought as if they were trying to fill the sky with darkness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sky of chaos….)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: In an instant, the beastman's territory evaporated in an instant, and the soldiers of the empire called Sylvaria swallowed all of Freios.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: And the original golem, created to protect life, invaded and destroyed this place.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Thanks to that, everyone died. It was someone's plan. Knowing that there is a source of light... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: However, they failed.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Because I was locked in a place I could never escape from. So they became nourishment for a dying place... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. What is that... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Spirits do not intervene in human affairs. However, it is different when humans cross the line.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: The child of Creed who reached the source of light with the fragment of Enteleche, the one who receives God's blessing... . I think two would be enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: My mission, El-Larsa, is to protect the Orcarium according to Orca's will... .
(The sphere of light around El-Larsa flows to his fingertips.)
(After a while, the light changes into the shape of a large window and flies toward Adventurer following El-Larsa's hand gesture.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Iris Goddess. Bury your Adventurer here… .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: It’s unpleasant… .
(El-Larsa looks alternately at Adventurer with a tired expression and at Adventurer's injured wings.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will admit that you are strong enough to deal with me, and that you are persistent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . It's not over yet.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Foolish human… . Still holding on. Although it is only a tool of God... . equipment… .
(El-Larsa looks sad for a moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa… ? Are you really blaming God?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: It's not about blaming God. Just act according to God's will. Yeah, actually, it might be anyone... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Because that's the only reason I'm here. I don't know if those who exist for life will be happy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait… . This situation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The contents of the data confirmed in the space-time network….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh no… . I can't die like that... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: You're making strange noises, like you've seen the future of death. Let's end now.
(With El-Larsa's words, all the light in the space flows to %s at high speed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I can't move... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Orca's light... .
(When a name filled with longing for someone is called, the light turns into a huge window and flies towards %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Am I going to die like this...?)
(Adventurer closes his eyes tightly as the fear of death, different from before, approaches.)
(At that moment, a light so large that you can feel an enormous pressure in your closed eyes approaches. A moment later, a sound like something exploding is heard.)
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwak!
(As %s carefully opens his eyes, his vision is filled with bright light. And in the sky, he sees a window of light that has been blocked and bounced by something.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: The moon at night embracing the light... ? The moon at night can't be here... ?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Goddess... , please forgive me.
(El-Larsa grabs the spear of light that bounces into the sky and jumps towards %s somewhere between the flashes of light.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Die, Adventurer of God!!
(The moment El-Larsa's attack, containing all its power, is directed at %s, a light explodes that is incomparably stronger than before, shaking everything in the Orcarium.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Goddess... .
(El-Larsa sits down as if resigned. After a while, the light that was encroaching on the area around the spirit stump disappears.)
(And in the midst of it, an image of someone bleeding is revealed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… , why is Iris here… .
(Iris is trying to smile, but is unable to hide the pain due to the spear of light embedded in his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm glad it's not too late.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Iris!! are you okay?!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm fine... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My scars will go away soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris always says that. Actually, it's not okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I didn't have time... , what would have happened if it was late... .
(The spear of light that El-Larsa made loses its power and slowly disappears. Then, the blood flowing from Iris's shoulder stops.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I came here because I didn't want to do something I regret.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is entirely my will. Please respect my wishes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The future of %s that I saved will continue. and… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: El-Larsa… .
(Iris holds out his hand, calling out the name of El-Larsa, who was sitting down.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: You came here because you knew what would happen if I hurt you.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Only then could that person have been saved... .
(El-Larsa stands up holding Iris's hand.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You can blame me.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: How could I blame you? Iris I wonder where there is a noble person who cares about this world like you... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I was just trying to protect this place and the spirits according to Orca's wishes... ,

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I guess that was different from the goddess's will.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Like the goddess, I have no regrets about my choice. However, it is a pity that it disappears like this... .

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I couldn't even meet Orca again... .
(As El-Larsa makes a lonely expression, his body becomes a little blurry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa… ?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: El-Larsa, the spirit that wounded its master, God. I will gladly accept the penalty for going against providence.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Please say hello to Gaia, who will wake up again someday... .
(The light slowly disappears from the spirit that held it. As if it never existed in this world from the beginning...)
(The place where something seemed to have happened just moments ago appears unusually dark.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason El-Larsa disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ceres… , Ceres must have made this choice as a star god... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… . Uh, Iris?
(Iris's face, which was smiling lonelyly at Adventurer, gradually turns pale.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, I have no regrets… .
(Iris tries to stand somehow, but his legs seem to lose strength and he falls down. Then he loses consciousness and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… , wait a moment. I support you… .
(The moment Adventurer tries to approach Iris, the ground begins to shake and crack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like when the enteleche of life disappeared... . Gotta get Iris!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Two spirits flying at high speed in the air block %s's path.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia? Geass?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I will tell you briefly.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: We will take care of Iris. I don't have time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No time?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Quickly go to where that child is. Otherwise everything will collapse.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris is… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Goddess will be okay. Believe it. As much as we trust you.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If you go there, you can go outside right away. Hurry up!
(As Harmonia and Geas approach the fallen Iris, an unknown force pushes Adventurer away. Then, the figure gradually moves further away and is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… , I guess it’ll be okay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I told you not to worry, it'll be okay... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris said my future would continue... , if Iris fails to appear… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And El-Larsa… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it just a result of choice? .

steps.name: request of light
steps.objective: Talk to [Narsha] in “Orcarium” and report the quest to [Peta] in “Orcarium”.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What just happened? It seems like the Orcarium was shaken... . Madori, you felt it too, right?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But why is the spirit so quiet... .
(Narsha pricks her ears and smoothes them out, but the sound that disappeared is not heard again.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I can't hear any sound. Why suddenly... .
(In the meantime, %s is seen approaching with an expression as if he is about to collapse at any moment.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: … Uh, Adventurer?!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer! Adventurer! Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha? Narsha, I’m glad. It stayed right here.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Are you okay? What happened in there? What about that spirit? Are you hurt anywhere? And No Name… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, please ask slowly, one by one. I'm a little distracted right now... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah, yes. sorry… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me tell you what happened there. Because I think Narsha can listen to the story... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I entered the spirit stump... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Narsha about what happened when you met El-Larsa at the Spirit Stump.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Such situations... I didn't find out about Noname.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I can't believe something like that happened... .
(Narsha looks at the sky of the Orcarium with a sad expression.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: These things didn't happen because I insisted on coming for no reason, right? Iris This happened to you too… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not because of Narsha. It's not our fault... . So it will be okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They must be the ones who want this to happen...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah, Adventurer. Look behind you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, what is this… ? It wasn't there until just now... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's like the orb of light around the El-Larsa spirit. I think I followed Adventurer... .
(The moment Narsha recognizes the sphere of light, a fragment of Enteleche shines in Narsha's pocket.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh… .
(The moment Narsha takes out the fragment and holds it in her hand, someone's voice is heard shaking the space.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: This moment is a part of the source of light that Larsa wanted to protect forever.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who, who is this? Is this voice…?)
(Someone's voice comes from the distance between the light and the debris.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: And the regret of a lackey who entrusted it only to his beloved Larsa... .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Now the remaining light leaves the Orcarium and heads towards the moon, flowers, and the god of plants... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (To Iris?)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: %s… , I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: … Don’t let Iris lose the light in your heart… .
(The light soon disappears before the two can understand the situation, and the fragment of Enteleche in Narsha's hand also turns into light and disappears.)
(Of the two people who were looking at the sky in silence in a place where the light disappeared, Narsha was the first to break the silence and speak.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I can't hear the spirits anymore. It seems like this light is disappearing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perhaps the light here disappeared as it headed toward Iris.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Who was this voice?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, but maybe he was someone who cared for El-Larsa... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, is Iris really okay? I said the light was directed to Iris, but still….)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That power... , It must have been good because he went to the goddess, right? I'm sure the goddess will be fine too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I-I mean that. At first, I came here because I was curious about my existence... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you have any regrets?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No. It was a bit complicated because a lot of things happened, but it's okay. In fact, I think it's better.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I have found what I need to do in the future, and if I continue, I may be able to find more answers.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Don't make it complicated, and don't suffer alone for no reason. If anything difficult happens, I will tell you right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. That's good.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's all thanks to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Shall we go back now?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, I want to go and rest quickly. But, will the wizard be okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, feta… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like he ran away towards the camp. Shall we go?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Come on, let’s go.

steps.name: Prophet's Waiting
steps.objective: Check the status of [Peta] in “Orcarium” and report the quest to [Narsha] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, we were worried for no reason.
(Peta is sleeping on the floor, covering a large magic book as a blanket. Moreover, he is talking strangely in his sleep as if he is dreaming.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'm so full of magic that I can't eat anymore... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did they set up a barrier or something around it? . If you see that monsters can't come in... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I guess I've been here all along. He said he would be dispatched, resolve the matter well, and go to the main office... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If possible, it would be better to quit working at the Magic Agency... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is a person you really don't know even if you know it... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, there is the same path we came from over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now let's go back to Esnil. Shall we go to Minos first?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You said you don't have to come, so I'll come later and talk about the situation. Or let's go together.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uncle Talos is also scary, but he seems to be okay... . Although I am worried about the guerrillas at the guard post.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Leave this wizard alone and go quickly. If you see that you are sleeping well in this situation, you will do well.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, then let's go back to Esnil.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes!
(As soon as Narsha arrived, she seemed to have relaxed and sat down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm fine. I guess I felt a bit relaxed after going far away for the first time in my life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Narsha… . What happened in the Orcarium... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, I know. I won't go around talking carelessly. Is it okay if I tell the president?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay if you're Dana.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… . Oh, I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm hungry too. Would you like to go to the guild inn and eat together?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, yes! I'll change my clothes and come out. Please wait!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should also eat at the inn and get some rest... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to think about the Orcarium thing again. Nothing much will happen to Iris, but still….)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I am here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori? Madori has also returned to her original black color.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I didn't know that, but it's true.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: … Uh, President?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Dana?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … Hey, are you trying to go to the guild inn now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was hungry, so Narsha and I went to the guild inn... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Would you like to come with me, President?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Not now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry for telling you this, but now there's a person here that bothers me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: President, no way… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Please listen to me just this once. Please… .
(At that moment, someone's hand comes up on Dana's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Dana, are you going to do this?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ugh, it’s late… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh? uh! Adventurer, please bow and be respectful.
(Narsha grabs %s's clothes and bends down together.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, who are you? .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: You don’t have to do that in front of me. %s, now raise your head.
(When I raise my head, a woman with blue eyes shining like jewels is smiling kindly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She is as beautiful as a halo... she is wearing a sun-shaped tiara.)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello… . By the way, do you know me?

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Of course.
(The woman suddenly grabs %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: I wanted to meet you, but I haven't had the chance. %s was busy too, as was I.

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Let me say hello.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What is this because of my stupid sister... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I am Kaina Dawn Sylvaria... , who is Dana’s older sister. Thank you for being a great help to my younger siblings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you too. But, if it’s Dana’s older sister… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, uh, huh?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire?!
